# Live-captured merge fixtures (issue #76)

Frozen in this directory are the parsed `SearchResult` payloads from **live**
provider queries — no invented HTML, per v3 spec §4.4. Each file is a single
JSON array of `SearchResult.model_dump()` objects, one file per provider.

## Capture provenance

- **Date:** 2026-08-02
- **Query:** `дюна` (run through each provider's real `search(query, http)`
  with the shared httpx client from `cs_uk_api.http_client.get_client()`)
- **Code path:** the actual `cs_uk_api.providers.PROVIDERS` registry
  (`import cs_uk_api.providers._registry` for side effects), not synthetic
  HTML or hand-built results.

## Per-provider result counts

| Provider | Site URL | Results captured |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `kinotron` | https://kinotron.tv | 7 |
| `eneyida` | https://eneyida.tv | 7 |
| `klontv` | https://klon.fun | 9 |
| `kinovezha` | https://kinovezha.tv | 1 |
| `serialno` | https://serialno.tv | 1 |
| `bambooua` | https://bambooua.com | 0 (queried, no match) |

`bambooua.json` and `doramyworld.json` contain empty arrays — those providers
were queried live with the same query and returned no matches; kept to record
the honest zero.

## Status

These fixtures are **frozen**: they are a point-in-time snapshot of the
providers' search output and are not regenerated by the test suite. If a
provider's markup changes, recapture with a throwaway script (see the ticket
#76 notes) and update this file — do not hand-edit the JSON.

Observed capture facts worth knowing when reading `test_live_merge.py`:

- Every captured item has `year: null` — upstream search cards do not expose
  release years, so the year-soft merge rule is **not** exercised by these
  fixtures (it is covered by the synthetic cases in `test_merge.py`).
- Cross-provider duplicates are real and plentiful: e.g. the movie "Дюна"
  appears on `eneyida` (3x), `kinovezha`, and `klontv` (2x) and merges into
  one group; the series "Дюна" appears on `kinotron` (2x), `klontv`, and
  `serialno`.
- `klontv`'s search is fuzzy: it also returned "Оголений страх" and
  "Падлоїд / Стерв'ятник", which carry no "дюна" alias and stay singletons.
